steps.name: QC and library-size assessment
steps.question: What are the library size distribution, count sparsity, and sample clustering patterns across the 12 skin samples (6 AD lesional, 6 control), and how does sample_01's ~4x-below-median library size affect its position in this structure?
acceptance_criteria: Reports raw library size per sample with sample_01 explicitly flagged and its fold-difference from the median quantified
Reports number of genes with zero or near-zero counts in sample_01 vs other samples
Produces a PCA or hierarchical clustering plot on variance-stabilized counts showing whether sample_01 is an outlier
States explicitly whether sample_01 should be retained with caution, downweighted, or excluded, based on the observed clustering/depth evidence, without pre-deciding the answer

steps.name: Differential expression: AD lesional vs control (DESeq2)
steps.question: Which genes are differentially expressed between AD lesional (n=6) and control (n=6) skin using DESeq2 on the raw gene-level Salmon counts, and how sensitive is the gene list to the low-depth sample_01?
acceptance_criteria: Runs DESeq2 with design ~condition, Wald test, apeglm or ashr log2FC shrinkage, contrast AD_lesional vs Control
Reports full DE results table (gene, baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, padj) for all ~12000 genes
Reports number of genes significant at padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1 (or states the exact thresholds used)

Re-runs the same DESeq2 model excluding sample_01 and reports the overlap (Jaccard or count) of significant genes between the full and sample_01-excluded runs, so the effect of the shallow sample on the final call is documented rather than assumed
States which gene list (full n=12 or n=11 excluding sample_01) is carried forward as primary, with justification from the T1S1 QC evidence

steps.name: Hallmark pathway enrichment (fgsea, ranked gene list)
steps.question: Which of the 50 MSigDB hallmark gene sets are enriched among genes ranked by DESeq2 test statistic between AD lesional and control skin?
acceptance_criteria: Uses the DESeq2 result table from T1S2 (primary gene list), ranks all genes by Wald statistic (or shrunken log2FC x -log10(padj) if statistic unavailable), and runs fgsea against the human hallmark gene sets
Reports NES, p-value and adjusted p-value (BH) for all 50 hallmark sets tested
Flags hallmark sets significant at padj < 0.05 with direction (up in AD lesional vs up in control)
If the hallmark gene set reference is unavailable in the environment at run time, reports this explicitly rather than substituting a different collection silently

steps.name: WikiPathways enrichment on significant DE genes
steps.question: Which human WikiPathways pathways are over-represented among the significantly differentially expressed genes (padj < 0.05) between AD lesional and control skin?
acceptance_criteria: Uses the significant gene set (padj < 0.05, |log2FC| > 1) from T1S2 as the query and the ~12000 detected genes as the background universe
Runs over-representation analysis against the human WikiPathways gene sets
Reports pathway name, WikiPathways ID, gene ratio, and BH-adjusted p-value for all pathways with padj < 0.05
If no genes reach the significance threshold, reports this outcome rather than lowering the threshold silently to force a result

steps.name: Volcano plot and summary of DE genes and hallmark pathways
steps.question: What is the consolidated view of top differentially expressed genes and top hallmark/WikiPathways pathways distinguishing AD lesional from control skin?
acceptance_criteria: Produces a volcano plot (log2FC vs -log10(padj)) labeling the top 15-20 DE genes by significance, from the primary DESeq2 result
Produces a bar or dot plot of the significant hallmark pathways (padj < 0.05) with NES
Cross-references any WikiPathways hits (T2S2) that overlap thematically with the significant hallmark pathways (T2S1) and reports concordance or discordance explicitly
Explicitly notes in the summary whether results changed materially when sample_01 was excluded, per T1S2's sensitivity check

plan.title: AD lesional vs control: DE genes + hallmark pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is bulk RNA-seq (Salmon-derived gene-level counts, 12000 genes x 12 samples) comparing atopic dermatitis lesional skin (n=6) vs control skin (n=6), unpaired, single batch. sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median, which threatens both normalization and the DE model if left unaddressed. The plan therefore (1) performs QC that explicitly quantifies and flags sample_01 and runs a sensitivity DE analysis with and without it, so the final gene list is not driven by one low-depth outlier; (2) runs a standard DESeq2 Wald test AD_lesional vs Control with shrunken log2FC (apeglm) as the primary gene-level result; (3) feeds the ranked gene list into fgsea against the MSigDB human hallmark gene sets (the reference asked for by the research question) to identify hallmark pathways changing between conditions; (4) supplements with a WikiPathways human pathway enrichment on the significant DE gene set as a second, independent pathway resource, since it is staged for human and gives converging or diverging evidence beyond hallmark alone. All steps operate on the actual counts.csv/metadata.csv, the actual AD_lesional vs Control contrast, and the actual n=6/n=6 unpaired design.
